input.quote: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice. Commerce One shall bear all costs and expenses of such inspection.
input.rationale: Audits are limited to once a calendar year by an independent CPA reasonably acceptable to us, at Commerce One's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and are confined to books and records with no access to our systems — at or above our preferred position. Notice is "reasonable" rather than a fixed 30 days, which we note only.

input.quote: If either party materially breaches any term or condition of this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within-thirty (30) days after receiving written notice of the breach, the nonbreaching party may terminate this Agreement on written notice at any time following the end of such-thirty (30) day period.
input.rationale: There are no liquidated damages, penalties, shortfall charges or early-termination fees payable by us; post-termination payments are limited to fees for continued Customer use and maintenance we choose to keep. Nothing to redline.
